This branch wires the opt-in durable runtime foundation into Gateway chat/agent runs, subagent fan-in/yield progress, context refs, shared SQLite runtime state, CLI/Gateway inspection, protocol schemas, docs, and tests.

Reproducibility: yes. for the review findings: current-main source and the PR merge result show the ACP task-owner gate and visible-request terminal cleanup gate diverge. I did not run live Gateway traffic in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] Two current-main Gateway invariant regressions are narrow enough for an automated repair attempt, while the durable stack acceptance remains a maintainer decision after those fixes.

target.title: feat(durable): wire agent session runtime coordination
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

This PR wires the durable runtime foundation from PR2 into agent/session/subagent paths so OpenClaw can record durable context for chat sends, agent runs, subagent child runs, parent fan-in, yield progress, and restart/recovery inspection.

The target behavior is: parent agents should have durable child/fan-in state; one failed child should not make sibling completion invisible; and Gateway/session restart should leave inspectable runtime state instead of silent coordinator ambiguity.

## Dependency Chain

This is PR3 in the replacement durable runtime stack:

1. PR1: durable session/task runtime RFC v2.
2. PR2: durable runtime foundation.
3. PR3: agent/session/subagent wiring, this PR.

This branch is stacked on the refreshed PR2 branch. The upstream PR diff against `main` is cumulative. For delta-only review after PR2, use:

https://github.com/mjnkao/openclaw/compare/codex/openclaw-durable-runtime-foundation-v2-ready...codex/openclaw-durable-runtime-agent-v2-ready

## Summary

Adds:

- Gateway `chat.send` and `agent.run` durable context refs;
- user-turn transcript durable context propagation;
- embedded-agent yield progress for resumable parent turns;
- subagent child-run mirroring and parent fan-in association;
- task completion contract metadata for durable parent/child lifecycle;
- status-notice display metadata for durable/yield progress;
- protocol schema fields for durable context references.

## Explicit Non-Scope

- Work module.
- Workboard UI/tools.
- Task Flow projection adapters.
- Retention/compaction.
- Postgres/multi-worker lease contention.
- Durable write controls such as cancel/retry/resume/signal.

## Latest Reviewer Follow-Up

Updated on 2026-07-02 after the latest ClawSweeper P1/P2 findings.

Head: `df88764a9f`.

Addressed ClawSweeper findings:

- P1: confirmed backend ACP manual-spawn child turns no longer create duplicate Gateway CLI task rows when ACP metadata proves the ACP spawn control plane already owns the requester-visible task.
- P2: visible requests that reuse recoverable terminal `failed`, `timeout`, or `killed` sessions now clear stale status, timing, runtime, and abort fields while preserving the valid session id.

Regression coverage updated:

- `src/gateway/server-methods/agent.test.ts` now covers confirmed ACP suppression, fallback CLI tracking for unsafe ACP-shaped cases, plugin-subagent precedence, and terminal reuse cleanup for `failed`, `timeout`, and `killed`.
- `docs/specs/durable-runtime-agent-session-pr-proof-2026-07-01.md` records the refreshed validation.

## Evidence

Validation after the latest fixes:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.gateway.config.ts src/gateway/server-methods/agent.test.ts`
  - 2 files, 350 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.gateway.config.ts src/gateway/server-chat.agent-events.test.ts`
  - 1 file, 99 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.gateway.config.ts src/gateway/server-methods/durable.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/chat-history-omission-logging.test.ts src/gateway/session-utils.fs.test.ts`
  - 7 files, 293 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.agents-core.config.ts src/agents/system-prompt.test.ts`
  - 1 file, 92 tests passed.
- `node scripts/generate-docs-map.mjs --check`
  - passed with `docs/docs_map.md is up to date`.
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/gateway/server-methods/agent.ts src/gateway/server-methods/agent.test.ts docs/specs/durable-runtime-agent-session-pr-proof-2026-07-01.md`
  - passed.
- `git diff --check`
  - passed.

Earlier focused validation remains recorded in `docs/specs/durable-runtime-agent-session-pr-proof-2026-07-01.md`, including:

- Gateway/context/server-methods shard: 6 files, 176 tests passed;
- agent tools shard: 2 files, 67 tests passed;
- durable fan-in/subagent/agent-turn shard: 3 files, 14 tests passed;
- Gateway durable matrix: 2 files, 4 tests passed;
- Kysely verify and guardrails checks passed;
- `npm run tsgo:core`, `npm run tsgo:core:test`, and `npm run tsgo:prod` passed on the stacked branch.

## Local Build Note

`env CI=true npm run build` was attempted locally. Dependency installation and bundled plugin assets completed, then the root `tsdown` build emitted only heartbeat lines for more than ten minutes and was manually interrupted. This is not recorded as passing build proof; CI or a maintainer machine should still run the full build before merge.

## Notes

This PR replaces the agent/session/subagent wiring portion of #97508 with runtime-oriented naming and a narrower dependency chain.
